stable_fields.title: EARS preservation screen and scorer harness

exact_blockers.requirement: Stage the exact EARS archive with per-item SHA-256, the CC BY-NC 4.0 terms, item provenance and a rights review that permits the intended screen and any listening use.
exact_blockers.state: No EARS audio, archive digest, item manifest, rights grant or licence copy is staged under data/. The historical report describes 743 mono 48 kHz WAVs but none is present; nothing was downloaded.

exact_blockers.requirement: Stage the exact prepared 16 kHz input manifest and every candidate output with matching item, sample count and SHA-256.
exact_blockers.state: The documented run directory data/runs/voice-enhancement-20261101-ears-preservation-743 is absent, including inputs/manifest.json, fastenhancer_small-results.json and deepfilternet3-results.json. No output was regenerated.

exact_blockers.requirement: Stage and hash-admit pystoi 0.4.1 non-extended STOI with its exact source, dependency lock and licence review.
exact_blockers.state: No pystoi source is staged in data/envs and no NumPy/SciPy scoring environment exists. The STOI port in the sibling stoi-estoi package is not imported or treated as the licensed scorer.

exact_blockers.requirement: Stage the exact DNSMOS P.835 script plus SIG and BAK/OVL ONNX models with immutable SHA-256, model terms and a declared window/hop.
exact_blockers.state: The documented dnsmos.py path and both ONNX model digests are absent. No predicted SIG, BAK or OVL value is computed or imported.

exact_blockers.requirement: Freeze the 743-item cohort, inclusion/exclusion rules, per-item failure policy, aggregation, bootstrap or uncertainty method and declared item-level scope.
exact_blockers.state: Only synthetic integer controls are exercised. No real cohort, item list, failure inventory, uncertainty procedure or independent review result is staged.

exact_blockers.requirement: Provide a separate rights-cleared listening design with consent/playback permission, randomized conditions, speaker labels and independent analysis.
exact_blockers.state: EARS has no speaker labels in the historical run and no permitted listening set or listener result is staged. Listening remains a separate blocked gate, never a proxy for the numeric screen.

exact_blockers.requirement: Review the opt-in developer/evidence harness, its exact pins, fail-closed behavior and scope before any SDK adapter publication or processor exposure.
exact_blockers.state: No provider, descriptor, registry entry, default, shared build or CI change is made. The harness is task-local, proposal-only and independently un-reviewed at this pinned head.

format.reference: same original input, no clean reference
format.sample_format: Q15 integer synthetic; no audio file

negative_claims: No EARS audio, prepared input, candidate output, corpus or rights grant was downloaded, copied, decoded or staged.
No pystoi, DNSMOS, NumPy, SciPy, ONNX Runtime, model or scorer was imported, loaded or executed.
No STOI, DNSMOS, predicted MOS, SI-SDR, SNR, RMSE, RTF, memory or listening result for any real candidate exists.
The authored integer Q15 controls are not a denoiser, not an EARS item and cannot qualify any component.
Historical source-reported aggregates are retained with provenance only; they are not reproduced, pooled or promoted.
No provider, descriptor, registry, installed v0 path, ABI, default, shared build, dependency lock or CI was changed.

public_boundary.registration: none; no provider, descriptor, registry entry or installed default is added

release_gates.requirement: Exact EARS archive, item provenance, CC BY-NC 4.0 terms and a written rights/redistribution review for the intended screen and listening use.
Exact prepared 16 kHz input manifest and every candidate output with matching item identity, sample count and SHA-256.
Hash-admitted pystoi 0.4.1 and DNSMOS P.835 script/models with exact source, dependency, licence and model terms.
Frozen no-clean-reference protocol: input reference, +/-100 ms lag bound, per-item failure policy, deterministic item-weighted aggregation and declared uncertainty.
Representative valid and invalid/missing real items validated through the exact reported bundle, including nonfinite and geometry rejection.
Separate rights-cleared listening or ASR/content control with speaker labels, randomized conditions and independent analysis.
Opt-in developer/evidence harness review with exact pins and no SDK provider, descriptor, registry, default, ABI, shared build or CI change.
Explicit proceed/defer decision and independent exact-head approval before any processor or public benchmark exposure.

reopen_condition: Stage the exact EARS archive and rights grant, the prepared 16 kHz input manifest and candidate outputs, exact pystoi 0.4.1 and DNSMOS P.835 artifacts, a frozen 743-item no-clean-reference protocol with representative valid/invalid validation, a separate rights-cleared listening control and independent exact-head review. Until then the decision remains DEFER, the evidence incomplete and the qualification not_qualified.
